description: Installs the LiteLLM proxy on a private Python runtime, independent of any Python in the image.
name: LiteLLM proxy

pythonVersion.description: Version of the private Python runtime that runs the proxy, as X.Y or X.Y.Z.

version.description: Version of the litellm package to install, as X.Y.Z. The default is a reviewed release; latest opts into the newest release on PyPI at build time.
